<span lang=\"ja\">キャリする</span> là một nề: キャリする is a career-consultation platform for the Japanese market, developed from an existing consultation chat service with a points-based payment model. The project focused on turning the structure of an existing service into a product with a clearer career focus, while keeping the core features that had already proven themselves.
Tôi phân tích ứng dụng tham chiếu và các: I analysed the reference app and the client’s requirements to rebuild the information architecture, wireframes and user experience from scratch. Rather than only redesigning the interface, the project reoriented the chat-consultation model into a product with its own concept and identity, built around career growth.
Tên <span lang=\"ja\">「キャリする」</span> đượ: The name 「キャリする」 combines career and suru (“to do”), expressing the idea of “taking action for your career”. This concept became the foundation for the experience and the visual language of the whole product.
Phân tích yêu cầu của Kyarisuru và tài l: Analysed Kyarisuru’s requirements and Stella’s documentation to decide what to keep, what to optimise and what to build new.
Tối ưu UX cho ba luồng chính: tư vấn, đă: Optimised the UX of three main flows: consultation, sign-up through the karte, and keeping and recovering an account.

Người đi làm cần một nơi để hỏi, nhưng k: Working people need somewhere to ask, without being “sold” a new job
Kyarisuru được định vị là dịch vụ tư vấn: Kyarisuru is positioned as a “匿名・斡旋なし” career-consultation service: anonymous, with no job placement. This targets the three barriers that keep working people from seeking advice, which are also the three things the design had to solve.
Khi cố vấn hưởng hoa hồng từ việc giới t: When advisers earn a commission from job referrals, users find it hard to believe the advice is really in their interest.
Chuyển việc, mâu thuẫn với cấp trên hay: Changing jobs, conflicts with a manager or pay are all sensitive topics. Users want to ask without leaving their real name.
Đặt lịch, điền hồ sơ dài, gặp mặt trực t: Booking appointments, filling in long forms and meeting in person make users put it off until the problem has grown.
Mục tiêu thiết kế: giúp người đi làm hỏi: Design goal: make asking about your career as easy as messaging a friend, anonymous yet with an answer you can trust.
Đọc kỹ đầu vào trước khi thiết kế màn hì: Reading the inputs closely before designing the first screen
Với tài liệu tính năng và một app đang v: With feature documentation and a live app in hand, research focused on these two sources instead of starting from zero. For each component I answered one question: keep it, optimise it, or build it new for the career theme?
Chụp và chú thích từng màn hình của Stel: Captured and annotated every Stella screen (splash, first screen, karte, login, home, tutorial, notification), noting the mechanism behind each one.
Đối chiếu yêu cầu và trường dữ liệu của: Compared Kyarisuru’s requirements and data fields with Stella’s feature list, screen list, specifications and screen flow to settle the design scope.
Hơn 80 hình tham khảo từ UI kit, app tuy: Over 80 references from UI kits, recruitment apps and blue-and-orange identities, as the basis for the new visual direction.
Kết quả phân tích được gom thành một bản: The findings were gathered into one decision table, the basis for the structure, wireframes and interface in the steps that followed.
